wish: someone should make a tool that generates treasure hunts
spec:
Turns an ordered list of hiding places into a chain of numbered clue cards, each saying where to hide it and pointing to the next spot.
Type places in order with an optional clue (blank gets a built-in riddle or a letter scramble), reorder them, then print the cards or play the hunt as progressive Q&A on the phone.
It does not hide anything for you, share hunts online, or use any network; stops are saved only on this device.
